Fedor understands that he is a weakling among the aborigines, so in the struggle it is necessary to use not force, but cunning and the ability to negotiate. Together with the shaman's daughter Reba, he goes to his main goal – to return home.

1380780.title: The Last Druid

When the imperial legions threaten to annihilate the ancient civilization, a peaceful Celtic elder is forced to betray his vow of pacifism and to take up arms to defend his family from the inexorable advance of the Empire in a clash that will decide the fate of an entire culture.

1397996.title: Hero's Handbook

With this strange guide in hand, Agnus is thrown into a hidden underworld, fragmented between heroes, villains and The Omitteds. The villains are about to join forces with The Omitteds in a rarely seen deal, as, equipped with dangerous bubble technology, they are now able to drain the virtue from almost anyone, even the heroes. With the villains' power growing, the world is on the brink of collapse. 1404588.title: Diane In The Loop

Between the one who wants to remember and the one who wants to forget, everything tightens.

1450988.trailerName: 25 CATS FROM QATAR - FULL FRAME TRAILER HQ (2025)

As he does so, his current reality battles him; he discovers that he must confront his worst fears. 1462060.trailerName: Ezma Teaser Trailer - إذما الإعلان التشويقي المبدئي

As they seize money and freedom, a revenge game begins—one that allows each of them to reclaim and rebuild their lives. The sight of women who have long gone with the flow of life, choosing to take their fate into their own hands even if it means crossing the line into crime, shines with a dazzling intensity.

1629356.title: Capturing Bigfoot

Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

1631404.title: Who Truly Knows What A Life Is?

1632812.title: Nothing Between Us

The sudden spark makes them face their own desires and changes them in deeper ways than they thought possible.

1634668.title: Сеть

1635756.title: Dance Film

In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

1638188.title: I'm Undercover

Huo Tao pretends to be a pickpocket and gains the trust of the gang leader, Lord Bei, and gets acquainted with a young pickpocket named Xiaofei. Cooperating with the police's plan, he discovers Lord Bei's collusion with others to steal business secrets. Finally, all the criminals are brought to justice, fulfilling Situ Qiang's wish.

1641580.title: The Last Assassins

In the distant future, Nobel must take a young girl to her aunt, whom she has never met, after her father has been killed. He has sworn to protect the members of that family, and few remain. When they arrive at an abandoned laboratory, holograms tell the family’s story. But can the digital world become physical? The young woman may be the solution.

1645164.title: Serpenti

Amid distracted police officers, zealous lawyers, fortune-tellers, and complicated bureaucratic red tape, no one takes him seriously. The man finds himself the victim of a Kafkaesque paradox: no matter how much he wants it, he cannot get himself arrested. He is the perfect scapegoat for a grotesque society that ignores those who seek redemption.

1646124.title: Tiger's Rampage

Once a towering figure in the scientific community, Vincent has since withdrawn from the world, isolating himself in relentless pursuit of a singular goal, bending time itself. For decades, he has obsessively dedicated his life to achieving the impossible: time travel. Now, in the year 2053, at 86 years old, he finally succeeds. But in his research, he uncovers a disturbing truth: time does not curve as once theorized; it moves in a straight, unyielding line. This revelation carries terrifying implications...  ﻿What happens when you travel back to the past and no one was there?
1646508.trailerName: LIMINAL - Official Teaser Trailer (Phycological Thriller Film)

1711660.title: Angela Allen: The Woman Who Saw Everything
1711660.overview: What do such classic films as The Third Man, The African Queen, The Misfits and Labyrinth have in common? Present during the filming of all of them was Angela Allen, acting as “continuity” – noting every shot and memorising all the details before her, working closely with the director, crew and actors to achieve a consistent and convincing world in front of the camera. She is one of the last witnesses to a truly golden age of cinema. Angela – who celebrated her 97th birthday in February 2026 – began her career as a 19-year-old on several British films, and then in 1948 was assigned to the second unit in Vienna for Carol Reed’s The Third Man. She subsequently became a regular aide to three great directors in particular, John Huston (with whom she made 14 films), John Frankenheimer and Franco Zeffirelli, as well as working with such diverse filmmakers as Tony Richardson, Ken Russell, Roman Polanski and Sidney Lumet.
